notes: Dell publishes no state, country or regional breakdown of employees, sites, investment or taxes for FY2025. The 10-K gives approximately 108,000 employees (no geography). Item 2 gives floor space only as U.S. facilities (7.2 million sq ft owned, 1.0 leased) and international facilities (4.2 owned, 5.9 leased), as of Jan 31, 2025; square footage has no unit in this lens, so it is recorded here and not as rows. Manufacturing sites are named only by country, so each owned-manufacturing country is a site entry without a city. The FY25 'Impact by the Numbers' brief (delltechnologies.com) has no geographic workforce data.
